title.narrative: Generation G - South Africa

description.narrative: The Generation G partnership strives towards the creation of gender-just and violence-free societies with and for young people in their full diversity. The partnership raises public support, advocates for improved policies and laws, and strengthens civil society, all as a way to contribute to gender justice. The partnership addresses three key interrelated challenges: gender-based violence, the unequal division of care, and women’s lack of access to civic space. The Generation G partnership is a collaboration of partners in Indonesia, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, Rwanda, South Africa, and Uganda, with a global consortium consisting of Rutgers (lead), ABAAD, Promundo and Sonke Gender Justice.

This target is for the whole programme period: We aim to get buy in and encourage commitment from decision makers by conducting engagements with national stakeholders consisting of policymakers, community beneficiaries and CSO’s on understanding the (National Strategic Plan to address Gender Based Violence and Femicide) NSP GBV+F The NSP GBV+F which consists of 6 pillars that address GBV prevention and response strategies. The South African coalition plans to create a space for youth and CSOs to influence debate and movement building. This will be done through awareness raising activities on NSP GBV and NYP after which we will implement a creative activism campaign on the NSP-GBV+F. The purpose of this campaign is to find creative ways of developing advocate for increased budget allocation, improved implementation and improved monitoring of implementation of the NSP GBV+F. We will also build the capacity of youth and CSOs in community mobilisation, lobbying and advocacy as well as providing technical assistance for policy submissions.
